description: ABAP代码审计规则配置 - 性能审计(必须) + 代码质量(可选)

P001.name: SELECT_ALL
P001.message: 使用SELECT * 全字段查询，应只选择需要的字段
P001.suggestion: 只SELECT需要的字段，减少I/O和网络传输
P001.example_bad: SELECT * FROM mara INTO TABLE lt_mara.
P001.example_good: SELECT matnr, ersda, ernam, mtart FROM mara INTO TABLE lt_mara.

P002.name: N_PLUS_1_QUERY
P002.message: 检测到嵌套SELECT查询，存在N+1问题
P002.suggestion: 使用FOR ALL ENTRIES或JOIN代替嵌套查询
P002.example_bad: LOOP AT lt_mara INTO ls_mara.\n  SELECT SINGLE * FROM marc WHERE matnr = ls_mara-matnr.\nENDLOOP.
P002.example_good: SELECT matnr, werks FROM marc INTO TABLE lt_marc FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_mara WHERE matnr = lt_mara-matnr.

P003.name: FULL_TABLE_SCAN
P003.message: 无WHERE条件的SELECT语句，可能导致全表扫描
P003.suggestion: 添加WHERE条件限制查询范围，避免全表扫描
P003.example_bad: SELECT * FROM vbak INTO TABLE lt_vbak.
P003.example_good: SELECT vbeln, erdat FROM vbak INTO TABLE lt_vbak WHERE erdat IN s_datum.

P004.name: NO_WHERE_CLAUSE
P004.suggestion: 添加适当的WHERE条件过滤数据
P004.example_bad: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mara INTO lv_count.
P004.example_good: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mara INTO lv_count WHERE mtart = 'HALB'.

P005.name: SORT_INSIDE_LOOP
P005.message: 在循环内进行排序操作
P005.suggestion: 将排序移到循环外部执行
P005.example_bad: LOOP AT lt_data INTO ls_data.\n  SORT lt_result BY matnr.\nENDLOOP.
P005.example_good: SORT lt_result BY matnr.\nLOOP AT lt_data INTO ls_data.\nENDLOOP.

P007.name: SELECT_INSIDE_LOOP
P007.suggestion: 将SELECT移到循环外部，使用JOIN或FOR ALL ENTRIES
P007.example_bad: LOOP AT lt_matnr INTO ls_matnr.\n  SELECT SINGLE * FROM mara WHERE matnr = ls_matnr-matnr.\nENDLOOP.
P007.example_good: SELECT * FROM mara FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_matnr WHERE matnr = lt_matnr-matnr.

P008.name: MODIFY_INSIDE_LOOP
P008.message: 在循环内执行数据库修改操作
P008.suggestion: 考虑批量操作代替循环内单条修改
P008.example_bad: LOOP AT lt_data INTO ls_data.\n  UPDATE mara FROM ls_data.\nENDLOOP.

P009.name: COMMIT_WORK_IN_LOOP
P009.example_bad:
LOOP AT lt_data.
  MODIFY mara FROM ls_data.
  COMMIT WORK.
ENDLOOP.
P009.example_good:
LOOP AT lt_data.
  MODIFY mara FROM ls_data.
ENDLOOP.
COMMIT WORK.

P010.name: READ_TABLE_WITH_BINARY_SEARCH
P010.message: 对未排序的内表使用BINARY SEARCH
P010.suggestion: 确保内表已排序后再使用BINARY SEARCH
P010.example_bad: READ TABLE lt_mara WITH KEY matnr = lv_matnr BINARY SEARCH.
P010.example_good: SORT lt_mara BY matnr.\nREAD TABLE lt_mara WITH KEY matnr = lv_matnr BINARY SEARCH.

Q001.name: NAMING_CONVENTION
Q001.message: 变量命名不符合规范，应使用描述性命名

Q002.name: MISSING_ERROR_HANDLING
Q002.message: 数据库操作后缺少SY-SUBRC检查
Q002.suggestion: 添加IF SY-SUBRC检查和错误处理
Q002.example_bad: SELECT matnr FROM mara INTO ls_mara.\nENDSELECT.
Q002.example_good:
SELECT matnr FROM mara INTO ls_mara.
ENDSELECT.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  MESSAGE s001(zmsg) WITH 'No data found'.
ENDIF.

Q003.name: MAGIC_NUMBER
Q003.message: 检测到魔法数字，应使用常量替代
Q003.example_good: CONSTANTS: lc_threshold TYPE p VALUE 100000, lc_rate TYPE p VALUE 0.1.\nIF lv_amount > lc_threshold.

Q004.name: HARDCODED_VALUE
Q004.message: 存在硬编码值，应使用配置或常量
Q004.suggestion: 使用配置表或常量定义
Q004.example_good: CONSTANTS: lc_hq_org TYPE vkorg VALUE '1000'.\nIF gs_vbak-vkorg = lc_hq_org.

Q005.name: MISSING_COMMENT
Q005.suggestion: 为关键逻辑添加注释说明
Q005.example_good:
* Check if status is active
IF lv_status = 'A'.
  lv_result = 'Active'.
ENDIF.

Q007.name: LONG_METHOD
Q007.example_good: FORM process_data.\n  PERFORM: validate_data, fetch_data, save_data.\nENDFORM.

Q008.name: NESTED_IF_DEPTH
Q008.suggestion: 使用CASE语句或重构代码结构
Q008.example_bad:
IF lv_a = 'X'.
  IF lv_b = 'Y'.
    IF lv_c = 'Z'.
      IF lv_d = 'W'.

S001.name: SQL_INJECTION
S001.message: 检测到动态SQL执行，存在SQL注入风险
S001.suggestion: 使用参数化查询或SAP标准函数
S001.example_bad: CONCATENATE 'SELECT * FROM mara WHERE matnr = ''' lv_matnr '''' INTO lv_sql.\nEXECUTE IMMEDIATE lv_sql.
S001.example_good: SELECT matnr, mtart FROM mara INTO TABLE lt_result WHERE matnr = iv_matnr.

S002.name: HARDCODED_CREDENTIALS
S002.message: 检测到硬编码的密码或凭证
S002.example_bad: DATA: lv_user TYPE string VALUE 'ADMIN', lv_pass TYPE string VALUE 'PASSWORD123'.

S003.name: MISSING_AUTH_CHECK
S003.message: 关键操作缺少AUTHORITY-CHECK权限检查
S003.example_bad: DELETE FROM vbak WHERE vbeln = p_vbeln.
S003.example_good:
AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'V_VBAK_VKO' ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '06'.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  MESSAGE e001(zmsg) WITH 'No permission'.
ENDIF.

S004.name: SENSITIVE_DATA_LOG
S004.message: 敏感数据可能输出到日志或屏幕
S004.suggestion: 脱敏处理，不输出敏感信息

B001.name: USE_NEW_OPERATOR
B001.message: 建议使用NEW操作符创建对象（ABAP 7.4+）

B002.name: USE_INLINE_DECLARATION
B002.suggestion: 使用 @DATA() 进行内联声明
B002.example_bad: DATA: lv_matnr TYPE matnr.\nSELECT matnr FROM mara INTO lv_matnr.

B003.name: USE_TABLE_EXPRESSION
B003.message: 建议使用表表达式替代READ TABLE
B003.suggestion: 使用 lt_table[ index ] 表表达式
B003.example_bad: READ TABLE lt_mara INTO ls_mara INDEX 1.

B004.name: USE_TRY_CATCH
B004.suggestion: 使用TRY-CATCH包裹可能抛出异常的操作
B004.example_good:
TRY.
    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_SOME_FUNCTION'.
  CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lo_error).
    MESSAGE lo_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
ENDTRY.

quality.name: 代码质量
quality.description: 代码规范与可维护性检查
